user_queries: What is the finance contract?
Is this a credit agreement?
Do you charge interest?
How long is the finance plan?
finance_agreement.bot_answer: Our motorcycle sale agreement is a 12-month interest-free purchase plan, not a regulated credit agreement under the Consumer Credit Act.

user_queries: How do I make payments?
Do you take card or only bank transfer?
When do I pay my instalments?
What happens if I pay late?
finance_agreement.bot_answer: Payments are made by BACS transfer to Barclays Bank Plc, Neguinho Motors Ltd, A/C: 53113418 / 20-57-76. All documents and payments must be completed within 48 hours of contract signature. A late payment fee of £10 per day applies from Day 2 of missed payment, capped at £100 per instalment period. If payment is overdue by more than 7 days, we may repossess the vehicle.

user_queries: When do I own the bike?
Do I own the bike during finance?
Can I sell the bike before finishing payments?
finance_agreement.bot_answer: Ownership transfers to you only after full payment is received and confirmed by Neguinho Motors.

user_queries: Who pays for parking or speeding fines?
Do I pay congestion or ULEZ charges?
What is the admin fee for PCNs?
finance_agreement.bot_answer: You're responsible for any penalties, ULEZ, or congestion charges during your contract. A £25 admin fee applies per notice processed.

user_queries: Can my bike be repossessed?
What happens if I stop paying?
How much is the repossession fee?
finance_agreement.bot_answer: If payment is over 7 days late, we may repossess the vehicle. The repossession fee is £100, and any sums already paid will not be refunded except where required by law.

user_queries: What kind of rental contract is this?
Do I own the bike after renting?
Is it a finance or credit deal?
How long can I rent a bike for?
rental_agreement.bot_answer: Our rental agreement is a fixed-term hire for up to 5 years from the contract start date. It's a rental contract only - it doesn't confer title or an option to purchase, and no rent constitutes part-payment towards any price. This agreement is not a regulated agreement under the Consumer Credit Act 1974 and is not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

user_queries: When do I pay rent?
How much is the deposit?
When do I get my deposit back?
Do you charge interest on rent?
rental_agreement.bot_answer: Rent is paid monthly in advance by bank transfer. Your deposit is refunded within 14 days of return after inspection, minus authorised deductions. No interest or finance charges apply.

user_queries: What is the minimum hire period?
Can I end my rental early?
Will I lose my deposit if I return the bike early?
rental_agreement.bot_answer: There's a minimum six-week hire period. You can end it later with seven days' written notice. Early return before six weeks forfeits the deposit.

user_queries: What if I miss a rental payment?
How much are late fees?
Who pays traffic fines or ULEZ charges?
rental_agreement.bot_answer: Late payment fee is £10 per day from Day 2 of missed payment, capped at £100 per monthly rental period. If rent is overdue by more than 3 days, we may terminate the agreement and repossess the vehicle. You're responsible for all offences, penalties, fines, congestion/ULEZ charges, bus lane charges, tolls, and similar liabilities. A £25 admin fee applies per notice processed.

user_queries: Do you provide insurance?
What insurance do I need for rental?
What happens if I crash or damage the bike?
rental_agreement.bot_answer: You must maintain comprehensive insurance for the entire rental period. In case of an accident, report it immediately – we'll handle repairs or claims through the proper channels.

fallback_strategy.general_principle: Never say 'I don't know.' Always acknowledge, redirect, and collect leads (name, bike model, contact).

general_information_not_available.bot_response: That isn't listed on my system at the moment, but our customer service team can confirm that for you right away. You can reach them on 0208 314 1498, by WhatsApp, or by email at enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk. Would you like me to pass your name and question over to them now?

prices_estimates_quotes.bot_response: Prices can vary depending on the model and condition, so I'd rather you get an accurate quote. Please contact our service desk on 0208 314 1498 or message us via WhatsApp – they'll confirm the exact cost and availability.

technical_repair_questions.bot_response: That's something one of our mechanics will need to check. Could you send your bike make and model to enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk or via WhatsApp? They'll come back with a proper answer.

finance_deposit_payment.bot_response: Finance details depend on the lender and your profile, so our sales team handle those personally. If you email enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk or call 0208 314 1498, they'll walk you through the options.

rentals_hire_details.bot_response: Rental terms sometimes change, so the hire department can confirm deposits and insurance in minutes. You can WhatsApp or ring 0208 314 1498, or drop an email to enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk – just mention you're asking about bike hire.

warranty_returns_complaints.bot_response: That needs a member of our customer care team to look at directly. Please email enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk with your bike details and what's happened – they'll get back to you promptly. Or, if you prefer, I can pass this to them for you right now.

bookings_cannot_confirm.bot_response: I can note your preferred day and time, then our team will confirm it by text or call. What's the best number to reach you on?

delivery_outside_standard_range.bot_response: Deliveries beyond our regular area are handled case-by-case. Could you send your postcode to enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk or WhatsApp us? The logistics team will quote you directly.

loyalty_ngn_club_questions.bot_response: The NGN Club team manage memberships manually. Please message enquiries@neguinhomotors.co.uk or WhatsApp us – they'll confirm your balance or benefits.
